title: Spaceship reportedly landed and was hushed up

tellings.quote:
reportedly a spaceship
landed it was all hushed up quieted and

plain: A spaceship is said to have landed and been taken to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio, with the whole thing kept quiet, in the words of Senator Barry Goldwater as played on the show: "reportedly a spaceship landed, it was all hushed up, quieted." Goldwater gives it as something reported to him, not something he saw. Coming from a senator, it suggests the story had reached the top of Congress.
